text: The Fed has removed its rate-cut bias and is now signaling a possible hike, while July payrolls unexpectedly fell 23,000 — this combination of sticky inflation and weakening jobs growth raises the risk of a stagflationary environment that could pressure both stocks and bonds.
SILG.L has a solid 15.3% gain but is now below its 50-day average with bearish momentum — consider trimming some profits here before the pullback erases more of your gains.

META at 16x earnings with 22% revenue growth and strong free cash flow is genuinely cheap for a company of this quality — adding on this pullback makes sense if you can handle short-term volatility in a slowing economy.
UNH at 17.6x earnings with nearly 12% revenue growth and a 4.5% free cash flow yield is a defensive grower that should hold up well if the economy continues to slow.
